specification.problem: Approximate synthesis of an n-qubit diagonal unitary with k distinct phases over Clifford+T, minimizing phase-rotation (T) count; the abstract gives only the T-count bound, not the construction.
specification.reconstruction_scope: Smallest useful construction: the diagonal operator definition, the abstract's T-count bound, and a tiny assumed instance (n=2, k=2) with a background phase-polynomial/parity view. The paper's actual decomposition algorithm, entanglement cost E(n,k) formula, and decision boundary in (n,k,epsilon)-space remain outside scope.

symbols.meaning: number of distinct phases in the diagonal unitary
quality factor of the single-phase-rotation synthesis method
total entanglement cost in T gates
equivalent T-count of the synthesized circuit

equations.label: Diagonal unitary
equations.description: Diagonal operator with k distinct phase values.
equations.abstract_quote: k$ is the number of distinct phases in the diagonal $n$-qubit unitary
equations.justification: Definition of a diagonal n-qubit unitary with k distinct phases follows from the abstract's description.

equations.label: T-count bound
equations.description: Upper bound on equivalent T-count: k rotations each costing about C_0 log2(1/eps) plus entanglement cost.
equations.abstract_quote: The equivalent $T$-count of the synthesized circuit is bounded by $kC_{0}\log_{2}(1/\varepsilon)+E(n,k)$

equations.label: Phase-class grouping
equations.description: Decomposition into projectors on phase classes, motivating k rotations rather than 2^n.
equations.justification: Plausible reading of why cost scales with k; the actual algorithm is not given in the abstract.

equations.label: Rotation synthesis precision
equations.description: Single-rotation Clifford+T approximation with T-count scaling logarithmically in 1/eps.
equations.justification: Known Clifford+T synthesis scaling; the C_0 identification with this per-rotation cost is inferred from the bound.
assumptions: Operator norm up to global phase

equations.label: Tiny instance
equations.description: CZ-like controlled phase instance with 2 distinct phases for illustration.
equations.justification: Chosen as the smallest explicit instance since no scope was given.

registers.name: q
registers.role: qubits on which the diagonal unitary acts; computational basis index x=sum_i x_i 2^i (assumed little-endian)

registers.name: anc
registers.role: possible ancillas for entanglement/parity computation; not specified in abstract

steps.description: Identify the k distinct phases and their basis-state classes for D.
Synthesize each distinct phase rotation over Clifford+T to precision epsilon (per-rotation cost C_0 log2(1/eps)).
Combine with a Clifford/entangling structure whose T cost is E(n,k) (construction unspecified) and check the total against the bound.

specification.classical_postprocessing: Classical computation of the distinct phases and the synthesis of each rotation; the decision rule comparing against prior methods in (n,k,epsilon) space is not specified.
assumptions: Scope chosen as the T-count bound plus tiny n=2,k=2 instance
Grouping by phase class is an assumed interpretation
missing_information: Definition and value of C_0 for the method
